subject: Manager calibration: engagement pulse follow-ups & flight-risk plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Retention Analytics <retention-analytics@consultco.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Manager calibration: engagement pulse follow-ups & flight-risk plan

Team —

Thanks for jumping on this quickly. The attached engagement pulse summary and the flight-risk scorecard are the output from the last two weeks (Q4 pulse + manager signals). I want to align on a tight manager action plan and guardrails for sensitive outreach. High-level asks: 

- Please review the scorecard ("flight-risk-scorecard-nov2025.xlsx"). It flags ~18 people at elevated risk based on combined signals (1:1 frequency drop, manager rating delta, sentiment).
- Identify which of those require an immediate retention conversation vs. light-touch manager check-in. Add your initials in column D of the scorecard by COB Tue 11/4.
- Monica: please confirm HR privacy guidance and any mandatory steps before we reach out.
- Vivek/Laura/Karthik: propose who should own the top-5 cases and whether to loop in our external coach (Retention Analytics).

I intentionally CC'd Retention Analytics; they can provide suggested manager scripts and anonymized cohort trends if useful.

We should keep this thread limited to the leadership group — do not forward names outside the recipients list. Sensitive note: do not add names into any company-wide documents or Slack channels.

Attachments: engagement-survey-summary-Q4-2025.pdf (summary), flight-risk-scorecard-nov2025.xlsx (editable), manager-playbook-sensitive-comms.docx (draft playbook).

I'll schedule a short calibration on Tue 11/4 4pm PT if that works for everyone.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager calibration: engagement pulse follow-ups & flight-risk plan

On Sun, 2 Nov 2025 at 09:12, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Thanks for jumping on this quickly. The attached engagement pulse summary and the flight-risk scorecard are the output from the last two weeks (Q4 pulse + manager signals). I want to align on a tight manager action plan and guardrails for sensitive outreach. High-level asks: 

Thanks Jonas — I skimmed the scorecard. A few quick reactions:

- I think we should separate "promotion-seeking" attrition signals from true flight-risk signals; three folks (rows 4, 9, 12) look noisy — they have high activity but low sentiment because of role transition chatter.
- Recommend owners: I can take ownership of two of the top-five (rows 1 and 3) given my relationship with those managers.
- Manager playbook: suggest a short script for 1:1s that avoids leading language and mentions available coaching — I'll add concrete language to the playbook and push a new version by EOD Mon.

Small ask to all managers: do not mention compensation or counter-offer pathways in initial check-ins unless HR is in the loop. That tends to escalate.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director of Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager calibration: engagement pulse follow-ups & flight-risk plan

Got it — thanks for pulling this together. A couple of operational notes from my side: 

- I agree with splitting noise vs. real risk. I'll flag the three noisy rows Laura called out for removal from immediate outreach.
- For the remaining top-5, I propose the following owners: Laura (rows 1,3), Karthik (row 2), me (row 5). I'll confirm with the managers this morning.
- Recommend we do a private calibration meeting (30 min) with Monica present; HR to advise on wording and next steps before any manager-level retention offers.

One more: let's avoid copying the full scorecard into Slack. If a manager needs access, add them to the Google sheet and set view-only until we confirm the outreach plan.

Vivek
Engineering Lead

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager calibration: engagement pulse follow-ups & flight-risk plan

Thanks for the heads-up and for keeping the thread tight. A few HR guardrails and recommended steps: 

- Consent & documentation: Before HR or retention coaches engage, managers should get verbal consent in a one-on-one to discuss development/support resources. We should document the 1:1 outcome in Workday private notes only (do not add to public profiles).
- Privacy: Redact or anonymize names in any distribution beyond the leadership recipients list. The scorecard is HR-sensitive.
- Benefits/coaching: Retention Analytics can be looped in only with employee consent. If managers want a coach, they can offer the option; HR will coordinate logistics and any costs.
- Offer language: No mention of counter-offer or compensation terms until HR approves escalation. If a manager believes compensation is required, escalate to Monica and CFO (via me) for approval path.

I'll review the manager-playbook-sensitive-comms.docx and upload a redline by EOD Mon. Also, I'll join the Tue 11/4 calibration for HR context.

—Monica
Monica Patel
People Ops Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager calibration: engagement pulse follow-ups & flight-risk plan

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Quick updates: 

- I updated the scorecard with owners per Vivek/Laura and redacted the noisy rows per Laura's suggestion. New file attached (flight-risk-scorecard-nov2025.xlsx v2).
- Monica: appreciate the guidance. Please post your redline to the playbook link when ready; we'll use that as the final script.
- Calibration: meeting scheduled Tue 11/4 4:00–4:30pm PT (calendar invite sent). Plan: 15 min to confirm owners and wording, 10 min HR next steps, 5 min follow-ups.

Action items: 
- All managers assigned: run 1:1s this week and report outcomes in the sheet (column E) by Fri 11/7.
- Monica to confirm any escalation steps for compensation by Thu 11/6.

I'll remove the external CC (Retention Analytics) from the next thread until we have consent.

Jonas
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
